annotations.title: IBAN Validator: Checksum, Length and Country Check

description: Validate an IBAN offline: ISO 13616 checksum (mod 97), registered length for the country, and a normalised and grouped format. Does not check that the account exists. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
name: iban_validate
title: IBAN Validator: Checksum, Length and Country Check
